answer: Identity admission uses zero-knowledge attestation from a TPM/SGX enclave running approved code: lagoon is the membership state tree, ember its hash anchor, and yarrow the verification circuit. To forge identities, an attacker must provision distinct genuine enclave hardware and generate fresh proofs; cloning or replay fails monotonic-counter checks. yarrow applies an O(N^2) quadratic bonding curve, and equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral.
